# Image Fitness Training

> Ireland's #1 fitness educator. REPs Ireland accredited Personal Trainer, Pilates, Strength & Conditioning, Nutrition, and Pre & Post Natal certifications. 16+ years delivering courses. 5,000+ graduates. Locations across Dublin (Swords, Tallaght), Cork, Galway, Limerick, Wexford, and Belfast.

Image Fitness Training (ImageFT, IFT) is an EQF Level 3 & 4 certified fitness academy. Every tutor is an active coach, not a lecturer. Graduates receive graded results (Pass / Merit / Distinction) and are placed-first with partner gyms based on grade.

## Core courses

- [Personal Trainer Course (8–16 weeks)](https://imageft.ie/courses/personal-trainer): REPs Ireland accredited. Three pathways — The Cert (€2,800), The Career, and The Business (includes Fitness Business Accelerator and professional brand shoot).
- [Mat & Reformer Pilates Instructor Course](https://imagepilates.ie): Delivered under the sister brand Image Pilates.
- [Strength & Conditioning Course](https://imageft.ie/courses/strength-conditioning): Post-graduate specialist pathway.
- [NutriCert Global 2.0](https://imageft.ie/courses/nutricert): Nutrition coaching certification.
- [Pre & Post Natal Course](https://imageft.ie/courses/pre-post-natal): Specialist exercise qualification.

## Additional resources

- [Fitness Business Accelerator (FBA)](https://imageft.ie/business-accelerator): The business side of personal training — content, pricing, sales, client retention, and AI workshops.
- [AI for Coaches Workshop](https://imageft.ie/ai-for-coaches): Standalone workshop on using AI tools in a coaching business.
- [Career Quiz](https://imageft.ie/career-quiz): Identify which fitness pathway suits you.
- [Course Pathway Quiz](https://imageft.ie/course-pathway-quiz): Narrow down to the right course.
- [Blog](https://imageft.ie/blog): Articles on fitness education, career advice, and industry insight.
- [Locations](https://imageft.ie/locations): Dublin Swords, Dublin Tallaght, Cork, Galway, Limerick, Wexford, Belfast.
- [Team / Tutors](https://imageft.ie/team): Every tutor is a practising coach.
